places.name: Lily's Bedroom
places.design: A small, slightly worn child's bedroom in an older house. Walls are a muted, cold teal-grey with peeling floral borders. The floor is dark-stained wood. A simple wooden bed with a star-patterned duvet is against one wall. On a shelf above the headboard, a soft yellow star-shaped night-light plugs into an outlet. A simple bedside table holds the baby monitor. A single foggy window shows the outside weather. At night, the only light is the night-light's warm yellow glow and the monitor's red LED. Outside is foggy and grey.

places.name: Mara's Bedroom
places.design: A modest, sparsely decorated adult bedroom. Walls are a similar cold, desaturated teal-grey as the rest of the house. The dominant furniture is a simple double bed with plain, muted bedding. A wooden bedside table stands next to it. The only object on the table is the baby monitor receiver. At night, the room is lit solely by the erratic red LED glow of the monitor's sound-activated lights, casting sharp red reflections on the dark wood surface.

places.name: The Upstairs Landing
places.design: A narrow, shadowy second-floor hallway in an old house. The walls and ceiling are painted a flat, dirty white that reads as a cold grey in the low light. The floor is dark, scuffed hardwood. A single, bare, failing lightbulb hangs from the center of the ceiling, its filament flickering inconsistently, casting a sickly, dim amber light that barely reaches the corners. All doors leading off it are identical painted wood. At night, this failing bulb is the only light source.
